Currently kvmppc_handle_exit_hv() is called with the vcore lock held
because it is called within a for_each_runnable_thread loop.

column2: we already unlock the vcore within kvmppc_handle_exit_hv()
and this is safe because (a) any vcpus

column1: that become runnable and are added to the runnable set by
kvmppc_run_vcpu() have their vcpu->arch.trap == 0 and can't actually
run in the guest (because the vcore state is VCORE_EXITING)
(b) for_each_runnable_thread is safe against addition or removal
of vcpus from the runnable set.

column2: in order to simplify things for following patches

column1: drop the vcore lock in the for_each_runnable_thread loop
kvmppc_handle_exit_hv() gets called without the vcore lock held.
